flows:

Get the text shown next to 'Trial ends' and save as {{trial_end}}.
Get the text shown next to 'Next invoice' and save as {{next_invoice}}.
Store all of those values first.
Only after every value is stored, verify that {{today}} is the correct calendar day, whatever format the page uses: {{today}} is Tuesday, 16 June 2026.

Verify that {{next_invoice}} is the correct calendar day, whatever format the page uses: {{next_invoice}} is Thursday, 16 July 2026.
